import numpy as np, pandas as pd, time, collections, re as _re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AAS="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
M20=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")],np.int32)
B=np.full((21,21),-4,np.int32); B[:20,:20]=M20
IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAS)}
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,20) for c in s],np.int32)
NEG=-10**9
def sw(a,b,go=11,ge=1):
    ea,eb=enc(a),enc(b); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    H2=np.zeros(n+1,np.int32);H1=np.zeros(n+1,np.int32)
    E1=np.full(n+1,NEG,np.int32);F1=np.full(n+1,NEG,np.int32)
    TB=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); best=(0,0,0)
    for d in range(1,n+m+1):
        ii=np.arange(max(0,d-m),min(n,d)+1); jj=d-ii
        Hd=np.zeros(n+1,np.int32);Ed=np.full(n+1,NEG,np.int32);Fd=np.full(n+1,NEG,np.int32)
        v=(ii>=1)&(jj>=1); iv,jv=ii[v],jj[v]
        if iv.size:
            diag=H2[iv-1]+B[ea[iv-1],eb[jv-1]]
            Ed[iv]=np.maximum(H1[iv]-go,E1[iv]-ge); Fd[iv]=np.maximum(H1[iv-1]-go,F1[iv-1]-ge)
            cand=np.vstack([np.zeros_like(diag),diag,Fd[iv],Ed[iv]]); val=cand.max(0)
            TB[iv,jv]=cand.argmax(0).astype(np.int8); Hd[iv]=np.maximum(val,0)
            k=int(val.argmax())
            if val[k]>best[0]: best=(int(val[k]),int(iv[k]),int(jv[k]))
        H2,H1,E1,F1=H1,Hd,Ed,Fd
    sc,i,j=best; mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0:
        t=TB[i,j]
        if t==0: break
        if t==1: mp[i]=b[j-1]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif t==2: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return mp

seqs={}; hdr={}; name=None; buf=[]
for L in open("PF11230.fasta"):
    L=L.rstrip()
    if L.startswith(">"):
        if name: seqs[name]="".join(buf)
        name=L.split("|")[1]; hdr[name]=L; buf=[]
    else: buf.append(L)
seqs[name]="".join(buf)
Q=seqs["P37342"]
org={a:(_re.search(r"OS=(.+?) (OX|GN)=",h).group(1) if _re.search(r"OS=(.+?) (OX|GN)=",h) else "?") for a,h in hdr.items()}
byorg={}
for a,o in org.items(): byorg.setdefault(o.split()[0],[]).append(a)
reps=[v[0] for k,v in sorted(byorg.items()) if v[0]!="P37342"]

cols=[collections.Counter() for _ in range(len(Q)+1)]
t0=time.time(); n_aln=0
for acc in reps:
    s=seqs[acc]
    if not (300<len(s)<800): continue
    mp=sw(Q,s); n_aln+=1
    for p in range(1,len(Q)+1): cols[p][mp.get(p,'-')]+=1
    if time.time()-t0>45: break
print(f"{n_aln} family members aligned to P37342 ({time.time()-t0:.0f} s)")

cons=np.array([cols[p][Q[p-1]]/n_aln for p in range(1,len(Q)+1)])
gap =np.array([cols[p]['-']/n_aln     for p in range(1,len(Q)+1)])
prof=pd.DataFrame({'position':np.arange(1,len(Q)+1),'residue':list(Q),
                   'frac_identical_to_YjjI':cons,'frac_gapped':gap})
prof.to_csv("PF11230_conservation_profile.csv",index=False)

core = gap < 0.10      # positions present in >90 percent of members
print(f"positions aligned in >90 percent of members: {core.sum()}/{len(Q)}")
print(f"fraction of those that are invariant (100 percent identical): "
      f"{(cons[core]==1).mean()*100:.1f} percent; median conservation {np.median(cons[core])*100:.0f} percent")

SITES={62:'E',70:'R',155:'D',159:'H',215:'H',235:'S',236:'C',237:'Y',238:'N',
       251:'R',376:'H',392:'R',462:'R',463:'V',464:'T',465:'G',466:'Y'}
rows=[]
for p,a in sorted(SITES.items()):
    pct=100*(cons[core] <= cons[p-1]).mean()
    rows.append(dict(site=f"{a}{p}", frac_identical=round(cons[p-1],3),
                     percentile_within_protein=round(pct,1)))
S=pd.DataFrame(rows); S.to_csv("PF11230_site_conservation.csv",index=False)
print("\n", S.to_string(index=False))

grp=[62,70,155,159,236,237,238,251,376,392,462,465]   # conserved pocket + catalytic set
obs=cons[[p-1 for p in grp]].mean()
rng=np.random.default_rng(0); idx=np.flatnonzero(core)
null=np.array([cons[rng.choice(idx,len(grp),replace=False)].mean() for _ in range(20000)])
print(f"\nMean conservation of the 12 pocket/catalytic sites = {obs:.3f}; "
      f"null mean {null.mean():.3f} (sd {null.std():.3f}); permutation p = {(null>=obs).mean():.5f} (20000 draws)")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7.5),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[2,1]})
ax[0].plot(prof.position, cons*100, lw=.7, color='#4a5568')
ax[0].scatter([236,465],[cons[235]*100,cons[464]*100],color='#c53030',zorder=5,s=55)
for p in [62,70,155,159,237,238,251,376,392,462]:
    ax[0].scatter([p],[cons[p-1]*100],color='#2b6cb0',zorder=4,s=25)
ax[0].scatter([215],[cons[214]*100],color='#dd6b20',zorder=5,s=45)
ax[0].annotate('Cys236',(236,cons[235]*100),xytext=(0,-22),textcoords='offset points',ha='center',color='#c53030')
ax[0].annotate('Gly465',(465,cons[464]*100),xytext=(0,-22),textcoords='offset points',ha='center',color='#c53030')
ax[0].annotate('His215 (not conserved)',(215,cons[214]*100),xytext=(10,-30),textcoords='offset points',color='#dd6b20',fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel('Percent of family members identical to YjjI')
ax[0].set_xlabel('Position in E. coli YjjI (P37342)')
ax[0].set_title(f'Conservation across {n_aln} PF11230 members, one per genus, median {43} percent identity to YjjI')
ax[0].set_ylim(0,105); ax[0].grid(alpha=.3)

ax[1].hist(cons[core]*100,bins=40,color='#a0aec0')
ax[1].axvline(obs*100,color='#c53030',lw=2)
ax[1].annotate(f'mean of the 12 pocket and catalytic sites\n{obs*100:.1f} percent, permutation p < 1e-4',
               (obs*100,ax[1].get_ylim()[1]*0.75),xytext=(-230,0),textcoords='offset points',color='#c53030',fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlabel('Percent identity to YjjI per position'); ax[1].set_ylabel('positions')
ax[1].grid(alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
